name: Nikketa

skills.name: Active Deterrence
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: K9 Deployment
skills.description: Selects an empty tile within a 9 tile radius, and summons Kulich, then deals AoE Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to all enemies within a 2 tiles radius of the selected tile, and applies Guilt for 2 turns. If Kulich is already present, teleports Kulich to the selected tile instead. Nikketa gains 1 point of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Judgement Strike
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius, deals Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it, and applies Guilt for 2 turns. Nikketa gains 2 points of Confectance Index and Extra Command.

skills.name: Righteous Verdict
skills.description:
Selects an enemy target within a 9 tile radius, deals Hydro damage equivalent to 130% ATK to it. If the target has Guilt, performs an additional attack, and removes Guilt

Consumes all Confectance Index, for each additional point of Confectance Index consumed, increases the damage of this skill by 5%

skills.name: On-site Enforcement
skills.description:
If Kulich is present, Nikketa gains Insight. Before Nikketa and Kulich activates their skill, both gains 1 stack of Clue, if Phase Weakness is exploited, gains an additional stack of Clue

Kulich can only perform Counterattack once per round. After performing Counterattack, Nikketa will follow up by using her ultimate skill Righteous Verdict against the target (Righteous Verdict does not have a Confectance Cost requirement)

summons.name: Kulich
summons.description: K9 police partner. Enemies will not select Kulich as the target of their attacks. Performs Counterattack when nearby allies take damage.

skills.name: Kulich's Loyalty
skills.description:
Enemies will not select Kulich as the target of their attacks

If enemies within a 3 tile radius deal damage, performs Counterattack, dealing Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK and 2 Stability damage

skills.name: Kulich's Intimidation
skills.description:
Decreases ATK for all enemies within a 5 tile radius by 10%

This passive is only unlocked after reaching Vertebrae 5

fortification.effect:
Damage multiplier increased by 20%

Extra Command is replaced with Extra Action

Damage multiplier increased by 20%. Decreases Confectance Cost by 1 point

If the target has Guilt, applies Monitoring on the target after skill activation for 1 turn
Doubles the maximum stack limit for Clue to 10 stacks. Kulich can perform an additional Counterattack per turn

Increases Stability damage by 2 points

Enhanced the effects of Guilt - Takes 10% more Hydro damage instead, and restores Kulich HP by 30% max HP after relocation

Increases the range of Kulich's Loyalty by 2 tiles. Increases Kulich inherited HP to 100%

Kulich gains Kulich's Intimidation
For each additional point of Confectance Index consumed, increases damage by 10% instead. Guilt will no longer be removed

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Righteous Doll
keys.effect: After using basic attack or single target skills, increases Confectance Index by 1 point

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Messenger of Justice
keys.effect: If the target has Guilt, deals an additional 2 points of Stability damage to it

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Valiant Aura
keys.effect: Judgement Strike: This skill now deals AoE Hydro damage equivalent to 80% ATK to all enemies within a 2 tiles radius

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Just Desserts
keys.effect: K9 Deployment: After skill usage, generates Tideaway in the effective area for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Stern Gaze
keys.effect: After attacking, if the target is in Stability Break, applies Fear for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Oppressive Air
keys.effect: When gaining Clue, gains Attack Up II for 1 turn

keys.name: Common Key - Defender
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / If the holder has Hydro type buffs, increases critical rate by 10%

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect:
After ending an action, gains 1 stack of Righteousness.
Each time Kulich performs 1 Counterattack, restores 1 point of Confectance Index for Nikita. The range of Kulich's Loyalty increases by 2 tiles.

Righteousness: Increases own Critical Rate by 30% and Critical Damage by 30% (this effect is fixed and does not affected by stacks). When actively using the Ultimate Skill Righteous Judgment, consumes 5 stacks of this effect to cast the Ultimate Skill an additional time. Can stack up to 5 times. Cannot be dispelled.
